card.name: Linking words before sugar and food items
card.fires_on: Small linking words like "of", "to" or "with" right before a food or commodity term, especially sugar, lactose, fructose, staples or agricultural goods. The linking word comes after a noun such as consumption, producer or intolerance.

modes.label: Consumption of sugar
modes.description: "of" after consumption or overconsumption, ahead of sugar or sweetened drinks.

modes.label: Producer or share of goods
modes.description: "of" after producer, a lot or per cent, before commodities or cargo.
modes.example: a large producer<< of>> agricultural commodities such as soybeans. Argentina

modes.label: Sugar intolerance wording
modes.description: A linking word in label text about lactose or fructose intolerance.
modes.example: severe degree of intolerance<< to>> lactose-containing products, or of glucose
